protocol.intent: minimal matched correction of the historical P1 with the correct physical coefficients; the old P1 remains a coefficient-mismatch diagnostic and 'must not be worse' is NOT an acceptance condition

subset.rule: Protocol-A train first 10 / val first 3; the original test 20 is frozen and evaluated exactly once after training

protocol.selection_policy: only the val-3 subset selects the epoch; test-20 is never used for selection, tuning or routing; no early stopping beyond the fixed epoch budget

norm.source: train-only z-score fit on the 10 train-subset geoms

physical_residuals.momy: rho*(u*v_x + v*v_y) + p_y - mu*(v_xx + v_yy) - rho*g_beta*(T - t_ref)
physical_residuals.domain: physical/stored units; the network output is reconstructed as y_phys = y_mean + y_std*y_net and autograd derivatives w.r.t. normalized coordinates are rescaled by 1/sx (first) and 1/sx^2 (second)

protocol.whiten_note: w=(cont=0.2, momx=1, momy=1, energy=1) is a pre-fixed scaling constant, NOT a measured RMS whitening; it is frozen and never calibrated from data or checkpoints

lambda_schedule.formula: lambda(e)=0 for e<=warmup; (e-warmup)/ramp_epochs for warmup<e<warmup+ramp_epochs; 1 afterwards

loss_terms_actual.note: all three objectives compute the same loss terms and only the selected terms enter the update; wall-clock time is therefore not a comparable training-cost measurement

boundary.definition: first 660 points of each geometry are wall points
boundary.bc_targets: u, v targets from the stored data (they are 0 by the dataset) and T from the stored data; no pressure BC and no hard-constraint envelope
boundary.collocation: interior indices 660..4999; compute_loss_terms draws one random permutation of the interior indices per batch step and applies the same n_colloc indices to every geometry in that batch (shared indices, not per-geometry independent draws); the input point order is not downsampled (full 5000-point provider)

protocol.pressure: raw stored pressure is used as-is for observations/evaluation; no pressure gauge shift or post-hoc translation is applied
protocol.not_ported: no checkpoint, selected weights, or normalization statistics from any earlier run are loaded; only the real residual/loss functions and core scoring are reused

test.evaluation_set: original Protocol-A test 20 geoms (ids=[17, 25, 32, 46, 47, 57, 66, 73, 83, 86, 96, 97, 98, 106, 109, 111, 113, 123, 126, 127]); scored exactly once after training, never used for selection or tuning
